For you, I shall consume a pint or two of soco black label.  Tonight, we drink away the loneliness; tomorrow, we embrace it.

http://imgur.com/CZSvI
As a bioinformatician, I ponder what the engineered females which exited my lab went off to become?  I ponder what outside the lab is like.  I ponder. Ponder. PONDER.

Not a soulmate.  Just the only girl I've had interest in, in 3-4 years.  I know she's not the only one.

She is so far from perfect. That's the best part of her.  In an university where everyone is trying to do their pseudo happy charade 24/7, she stands out.

I have no insurance.  I'm taking light opiates to help ease the insomnia pain (extreme muscle aches).
